recipes.name: gitlab-mr-watch
recipes.description: Watch new comments on a specific GitLab MR. Each new review note dispatches the mr-review-fix pipeline.
recipes.author: forge

pipelines.name: mr-review-fix
pipelines.description: GitLab MR review-feedback responder: checkout, ask Claude to apply the fix, push + reply. Requires glab CLI.
